what: A full-screen hero photo panel, as the page scrolls from 0 to 400px, inner padding grows linearly 0 → 40px (20px on phones), shrinking the photo inside its border — a hero where a background-colored frame closes in from all sides

options.to: End margin — a number (px) or with a unit like 40rem·3vw, default 40px
options.to-narrow: End margin for windows 1023px and below — if absent, to as is (brand 20rem)
options.end: Scroll distance (px) to reach the end margin, default 400

from.where: index.js .hm-hero (original .top-main --image-padding — PC 40rem · phone 20rem, scrollY / 400 clamped to 0–1 and updated with rAF)
